Players Committee card image of [[Quiggold]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. While piloting Meson Martinet, it is defense value +2. Forfeit +2 while present with Sidon. If your Rep is a pirate (or you did not deploy an Objective), Force drain +1 here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/quiggold.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
